findings.summary: Clarify whether changed-package dry-run retains payload preflight or becomes metadata-only preview.
findings.reason: Index entries omit files, so zero-fetch dry-run cannot preserve existing payload path/ownership/platform checks.
findings.suggestion: Prefer zero fetch only for unchanged dry-run; otherwise document metadata-only preview limits explicitly.
findings.resolution: Planner accepted unchanged/no-op dry-run zero-fetch only; changed dry-run preserves prepare/preflight without installed-state writes or hooks.

implementation_notes: Retained graph nodes use complete index dependencies/members before collection update trimming.
Keep final validation against unselected installed nodes and preserve manual installation reasons.
Do not invoke Manager.install on retained nodes; zero-target-inspection acceptance applies to named repository install/update, excluding initial build-local catalog/input-protection checks.
Changed writes must not overwrite any source archive or its ancestor, including archives of retained nodes.
Bind once-decoded archive metadata and raw-byte integrity to its validated index entry before self-update.
Do not add compensating local-content checks; user accepts local edits.
data.validation: Static source review only; no runtime, compile, tests, build, installation, network, Git or workflow-state mutations.
